title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. Aslwqm my brother is getting engaged,he has to go to the fiancee's residence and both have to sit on the stage. Relatives wil present gifts etc to them. My brother is denying. Now there is a quarrel between my parents and borother. My abbu says he will do something if he will not go there, as this is the question of prestige and status.So what my brother should do in this case?Please if possible dont put this question on the net. Allah hafiz 2075 views Q. I am 27 year old girl whose parents are tabligh. I married a man of my own wish who is also hanafi but is of silsila qadriya. my father object to my marriage and kidnapped me. is this permissable in islam. Also i have been separated from husband for 5 months. Father refuses to allow me to go back. we are from gujarat india. is this all permissable in islam. 5136 views Q. Is it permissible in Islam to hold Walima without Rukhsati, and can both families share Walima expenses? 12279 views Q. Seeking advice about elder brother's marriage 3611 views Q. Problem in Marriage 2479 views Q. I want to know we had marriage in court in front of Qazi and advocate without involving our parents 3617 views Q. I have been married for the past 30 years. My younger brother is married to my wife's younger sister. 3397 views Q. pregnancy ke dauraan apni biwi se sohbat suru ke teen mahine ke baad karna sahi hai?agar sahi hai to kab tak kar sakte hai? 2.kya shohar biwi ka ek dusre ki sharamgaah ko munh me lena jayaz hai? 20001 views Q. Dealing with a wife who has separated from husband without husband's consent and taking away the kids 3529 views Q. We are writing this email to you as we are in utter distress. My husband and I both are born Muslims (Alhamdulillah) from India and are currently residing in the UAE. We have a grownup daughter who had gone to Canada for higher studies. There she met one Sikh boy and they decided to get married; now our daughter is asking our permission. The girl is 23 years of age and the boy is 27. Both are having good jobs in their respective country of residences. Facts: The boy is ready to accept Islam before getting married to the girl. The boy is ready to come to the UAE to revert to Islam, learn everything and get married as per the Muslim tradition. (Nikah) The conversion is going to be kept secret from the boys parents. Currently the boys parents are ready to accept a Muslim girl as their daughter-in-law. After the wedding the girl will be living with the boy and his parents in the same house. The boys parents do not have any objection to the girl following her faith in their house. The boy will be following/practicing Islam in secrecy. The boy is their only male child so he cannot abandon them to live separately with the girl. As the girls parents we met the boy and his family. The boy is very nice and sincere and is promising that he would follow the new faith and will keep our daughter happy. The parents are also very nice also said that they have no issues if the girl is going to continue to keep her faith after marrying their boy. But they do not wish their son to change his faith. Issues: (2) Is it correct for an individual to revert to Islam in secrecy of his parents and especially for a girl? (3) Will the boy be able to practice Islam in that house? (4) What will be the fate of their children? (5) The boy is promising us that their children will follow the faith of the mother (Islam) and not of the paternal grandparents (Sikhism). (6) Dilemma: If we give our consent to this marriage then we will be taking a big risk by allowing our daughter to spend the rest of her life with a threat of the boy going back to his old faith (7) If we say no then we are afraid of stopping/denying an individual to embrace Islam. We are requesting you to kindly guide us with either Fatwa or advise so as to make the decision easy for us. As we love our daughter like all parents; we are trying to work a way for her happiness. Kindly treat this matter as URGENT and reply as soon as possible. 4941 views Q. As'salamu alaikum va rahmathullahi va barakathou!! This is regarding the proposal I got for my marriage from one of the family. The girl's father is working in a vehicle insurance company. I am not aware whether the money earned by this profession is halal / haram according to Islamic Shariah. If it haram, obviously the children are brought up by the same money. In such a situation is it desirable to marry the girl. Please provide your suggestions. Waiting for your reply in anticipation. Jazakallahu Khairan..... 1840 views Q. I am doing job in UAE.before two year my marrige was done . before 1 and 1/2 year living alone in UAE. my wife in india. my salary is also less i cant afford to family with me. please reply me what can i do? 2563 views Q. Asalamualaykum Mufti Sahib, Is adoption permissible in Islam? My eldest daughter is married to my fathers real brothers son 20 years ago. She has 3 children out of the marriage. Someone told me that the nikah is invalid because of the uncle-neice relation. Is it so? If it is invalid, then what is to be done now? Please reply at the earliest. 2943 views Q. In one fatwa,a person asked from u:Is it jayaz for man to meet his wife before marriage or a man and woman can meet each other before marriage and select each other only after seeing each other? U replied :A man and woman, before nikah, are like strangers; they can not see and meet each other. It is not right to see the girl you want to marry by appointing a meeting; it is allowable only if you see her by chance. It is better to get a proposed girl seen by ones relative women. In another fatwa a person asked:Assalamalaikum I have come to know that it is not permissible to even look at 'ghair-mahram', i.e., someone who you are eligible to marry with. If this is true, then how can a person - male or female - decide his/her future spouse? U replied:It is prohibited to look at ghar-mahram, (strange opposite sex) but if you intend to marry a girl then you can see her once, rather it has been declared allowed in a hadith. Please clarify this can we see a girl which we intend to marry.After seeing her if we doesn't like to marry her so it will be ok to regect and see another girl? 13189 views Q. Islamic knowledge 8321 views
answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 64866 Country: India Title: Marriage between first cousins generations after generations Question: I was listening to a video of Dr Zakir Naik in which he mentions about a saying of Prophet Muhammad not to marry first cousins generations after generations in a family repeatedly as it increases the risk of genetic disorder. I would like to know if there is really a Hadith against the same. Answer ID: 64866 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 779/778/N=08/1437) I could not find out any such authentic Hadith in the collection of Hadith. Had you quoted the reference of any Hadith book we would have written something regarding its status of Sanad or Matan . Note: Zakir Naik is deviant in view of his thoughts and is misguiding others. You cannot trust his explanation of Quran and Hadith. Hence common Muslims should not listen or watch his audio or video, and none of his book or written things should be read so that one is saved from his false and baseless and misguiding thoughts. قال ابن سيرين : إن هذا العلم دين فانظروا عمن تأخذون دينكم (مقدمه مسلم شريف، ص 11، مطبوعه: مكتبه اشرفيه ديوبند) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
